name: Rumor
description: Unverified circulating claims whose truth is left to the GM

fields.description: A creature of the {{ monster.name }} type was supposedly seen near the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is said to be buying unusual quantities of the material known as {{ material.name }}.
A valuable cache is allegedly hidden beneath the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is supposedly preparing a secret action against a nearby rival.
Followers of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} are said to be announcing—or concealing—an ominous revelation.
Routes through the region known as {{ region.name }} have supposedly become dangerous, though travelers disagree about why.
A missing person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background was reportedly seen inside the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A site described as {{ site.generator.name }}, long believed abandoned, is supposedly occupied.
The unusual item known as {{ curio.name }} is said to have changed hands several times in only a few days.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is reportedly paying discreetly for the following service without explaining why: {{ service.name }}.
It is whispered that {{ faction.name }} covertly enables the following criminal activity through intermediaries: {{ crime.name }}.
Someone with the {{ background:noble.generator.name }} background is reportedly being prepared in secret to replace the leaders of a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
Merchants claim that {{ faction.name }} is withholding the material known as {{ material.name }} to force prices higher.
Followers of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} are rumored to perform a forbidden rite beneath the building called {{ building.name }}.

A sacred relic of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} is said to be hidden in the custody of {{ faction.name }}.
A concealed passage allegedly connects the building known as {{ building.name }} to a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Shipments of the material known as {{ material.name }} from the region called {{ region.name }} are blamed for cases of the affliction {{ affliction.name }}.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is rumored to pay someone with the {{ background:criminal.generator.name }} background for information about prominent citizens.
Travelers claim that {{ crime:piracy.name }} has returned to routes bordering the region known as {{ region.name }} after years of calm.
Unconnected people reportedly share the same dream about an approaching change at a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is said to possess proof of a scandal that could destabilize a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
{{ faction.name }} is rumored to be breeding creatures of the {{ monster.name }} type beneath the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background is said to have been involved in the following criminal activity: {{ crime.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is reportedly recruiting outsiders discreetly to provide the following service: {{ service.name }}.
